title: Bugs Bunny Portrait
description: Bugs Bunny is depicted from the chest up, centered in the frame with his head turned slightly to his right. He has a wide grin showing his teeth, large expressive eyes, long upright ears with pink interiors, and his classic grey and white fur coloring.
prompt: Bugs Bunny shown from the chest up with a wide toothy grin and large expressive eyes, long grey ears with pink interiors, classic white muzzle and grey fur, positioned against a vibrant abstract painterly background with bold yellow, orange, red and black brush strokes and splatters in an energetic modern art style
